measure_name: Good jobs and skills: overall assessment
description: Quarterly narrative judgement on progress across the good jobs measures.
definition: Owner's summary of measures 1.01 to 1.03, agreed at the quarterly board.

description: Residents who started paid work after support from a GM employment programme.
definition: Count of job starts verified by providers in the month. Excludes starts under 16 hours a week.

description: Share of apprentices who complete and pass their apprenticeship.
definition: Achievements divided by leavers in the quarter, times 100.

description: Employers signed up as members of the Good Employment Charter.
definition: Count of member organisations on the last day of the month.

measure_name: Housing supply summary: net additional homes
description: All net additional homes delivered across Greater Manchester.
definition: Net additions (new build plus conversions minus demolitions) in the financial year.

description: Affordable homes completed. Shares reference 1.01 with its parent in the source plan.
definition: Completions of social rent, affordable rent and shared ownership homes in the financial year.

description: Households living in temporary accommodation at month end.
definition: Snapshot count on the last day of the month across the ten councils.

description: People found sleeping rough on a single autumn night.
definition: Official autumn count or estimate, summed across the ten councils.

description: Passenger journeys on franchised bus services.
definition: Boardings recorded by ticket machines, Monday to Sunday.

description: Share of timed stops served between 1 minute early and 5 minutes late.
definition: On-time departures divided by all timed departures, times 100.

description: Calls answered by the customer contact centre.
definition: Answered inbound calls, 08:00 to 18:00.

description: Share of the day the public website was available.
definition: Minutes available divided by 1,440, times 100.

description: Revenue spend in the month. Under and overspend are both a concern, so no RAG.
definition: Actual revenue expenditure posted to the ledger for the month.

description: Greenhouse gas emissions in kilotonnes CO2 equivalent.
definition: Territorial emissions within the scope of influence of local authorities, ktCO2e.

description: Sessions attended as a share of possible sessions.
definition: Attended sessions divided by possible sessions, times 100, all state schools.

description: Pupils missing 10% or more of possible sessions.
definition: Persistently absent pupils divided by all pupils, times 100.

measure_name: 16 and 17 year olds not in education, employment or training
description: Share of 16 and 17 year olds who are NEET or whose activity is not known.
definition: December to February average, NEET plus not known, times 100.

description: Learners starting a Skills Bootcamp.
definition: Learners who attended the first session in the quarter.

description: Data and analysis requests closed within the agreed 10 working days.
definition: Requests closed within SLA divided by all requests closed in the week, times 100.

measure_name: Gender pay gap report published on time
description: Whether the statutory gender pay gap report was published by the deadline.
definition: 1 if published by the statutory deadline, otherwise 0.

description: Residents attending jobs fairs and recruitment events.
definition: Unique attendees signed in at events in the month.
retired_reason: Replaced by measure 1.01 when events moved into the employment programme.

description: Temporary accommodation case reviews completed.
definition: Reviews signed off by a team leader in the fortnight.
